scope: Static source, retained TTGIR/PTX, and compilation-resource audit. This agent did not run GPU workloads or edit compiler/kernel sources.
line_number_convention: Compressed IR/PTX citations use one-based lines after gzip decompression. Source citations use one-based repository lines.

central_finding.claim: For the examined direct-load loops, stages=2 allocates one shared slot per load and schedules current computation before next-iteration copies. No floating-point work from another iteration appears between issue and the next wait in the retained PTX.
central_finding.qualification: Some overlap remains with copy/address instructions, predicates, pointer/counter updates, the backedge, and execution of other warps/CTAs. This is not a claim of zero hardware overlap or a profiled bottleneck.

mechanisms.name: shared staging and synchronization
mechanisms.claim: Direct register loads become asynchronous global-to-shared copies followed by shared reads, commit/wait protocol and compiler-required shared-memory barriers.
mechanisms.qualification: Do not remove barriers as an ablation. Their placement implements the block programming model and protects buffer reuse.

mechanisms.name: tail zero-fill copies
mechanisms.claim: The stage2 prologue plus N loop-bottom issues executes a final masked-off copy after the last useful iteration. Ignore-source copies still write zeros to shared memory and commit. An empty-token postloop wait drains outstanding copies.
mechanisms.qualification: This establishes extra shared-memory/issue work, not extra global reads. Deeper stages have additional prologue and tail protocol work.

mechanisms.name: one commit per source load
mechanisms.claim: createAsyncCopy creates one commit immediately after each load copy. Resize retains four load streams and four commits per steady iteration.

mechanisms.name: logsoftmax cache modifier changes
mechanisms.claim: Default ordinary ld.global.v4.b32 is converted to 16-byte cp.async.cg in the examined logsoftmax configuration. Smaller rotary and resize transfers use cp.async.ca.
mechanisms.qualification: A cache-policy effect is a measurable hypothesis, not established by static inspection. The second logsoftmax loop rereads gradient data from the first loop.

mechanisms.name: no blanket register-pressure explanation
mechanisms.claim: Same-config logsoftmax registers fall from28 to23 and rotary w2 stays at26, with no spills, while both stage2 candidates regress. Large resize tiles do increase registers, but cannot explain every regression.
mechanisms.qualification: Registers/shared bytes alone do not establish achieved occupancy, residency, bank conflicts, cache misses, or a runtime bottleneck. Use profiler evidence.

safe_ablations: Sweep stages3/4 while holding launch configuration, contracts and mathematical work fixed; inspect buffers and waits, not merely the stages label.
Force cache_modifier=.ca on source loads for logsoftmax, separately from changing stage count.
Pipeline the logsoftmax reduction and output loops separately. The read-only first loop needs no no-alias proof; the store-containing second loop does.
Compare same launch configuration before interpreting independently tuned winners.
If investigating shared overhead further, use a valid register-prefetch or deduplicated gather implementation with full-output validation, rather than deleting required waits or barriers.

deeper_stage_source_explanation.claim: Direct-load latency and buffer count increase with stages-1. Reverse cluster order persists, but greater iteration distance exposes useful interiteration work. Wait counts are recomputed from commit-token distance after pipeline expansion.
deeper_stage_source_explanation.qualification: Resize wait_group8 is retained as an observed emitted instruction; this static audit makes no unsupported hardware group-limit claim.

resize_remaining_structure.claim: Deeper stages expose overlap but preserve four separate gathers and four independently committed shared streams for only four multiplies and three adds per output element. They add ring-index update/address work.

gather_reuse.enumeration: For each tile bx in0..7, by in0..63: collect h=min(floor(y*63/127)+dy,63), w=min(floor(x*255/511)+dx,255), dy/dx in{0,1}; count Cartesian-product source positions.
gather_reuse.qualification: Counts describe the exact-rational intended coordinate mapping, not a GPU trace or bit-for-bit reconstruction of floating-point division. Both baseline and pipeline perform these gathers. Repeated global addresses may hit caches or combine within transactions; no extra DRAM-byte claim follows. Pipeline separately materializes the gathered values in four shared buffers, without deduplicating them.

# Compute the source coordinates
    if ALIGN_CORNERS:
        # When align_corners is True, map corners to corners
        # real_h = oh * (IH - 1) / (OH - 1) when OH > 1
        real_h = tl.where(
            OH > 1,
            oh.to(tl.float32) * (IH - 1) / (OH - 1),
            tl.zeros_like(oh).to(tl.float32),
        )
        real_w = tl.where(
            OW > 1,
            ow.to(tl.float32) * (IW - 1) / (OW - 1),
            tl.zeros_like(ow).to(tl.float32),

# Get integer parts (top-left corner of the 2x2 region)
    h0 = real_h.to(tl.int32)
    w0 = real_w.to(tl.int32)

    # Clamp to ensure we don't go out of bounds
    h0 = tl.minimum(h0, IH - 1)
    w0 = tl.minimum(w0, IW - 1)
    h1 = tl.minimum(h0 + 1, IH - 1)
    w1 = tl.minimum(w0 + 1, IW - 1)
